_output_clamp_comment: TOKEN CLAMPS (plan budgets around these): opencode #20078 hardcodes max_tokens=32000 for LM Studio (config limit.output ignored); LM Studio #1829 silently caps generation ~10-16k tokens on qwen3.6 thinking models (finish_reason:stop, no error) so long thinking eats the cap and the turn ends mid-plan. Assume <=10k REAL output per turn on qwen3.6-thinking via LM Studio; for long unattended runs prefer bare llama-server (no cap observed). Min opencode: the finish_reason continuation fix (#14972/PR#14973) landed ~v1.2.11 - older builds stop after every tool call on OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
_plugin_comment: Auto-continue plugins for the ACCIDENTAL-pause failure modes (stream stall, raw-text <function=...> tool calls per #24316, idle-with-pending-todos). Both have bounded-retry guards (maxRetries/maxAutoSubmitsPerTodo=3) so they cannot run away. PROVIDER SCOPE: enable for LOCAL providers only. On metered cloud (GitHub Copilot #8700, Vertex) each injected continue bills as a premium user turn - keep these OFF there and rely on the prompt-side PERSISTENCE.md rule instead. Remove entries here for a cloud-only config.
_research_strategy_comment: Web research goes through OUR tools — never opencode built-ins, no external services. webfetch + websearch are disabled below so the LLM is forced to use playwright-search: multi-engine search + extraction, with our own zero-dep pull (bpm-pull, fast no-browser fetch) falling back to Playwright for JS-heavy/Cloudflare pages. This eliminates the most common research-flakiness root cause (LLMs reaching for opencode's built-in webfetch and getting raw HTML or rate-limited) with no self-hosted Docker dependency.

mempalace._comment: Local AI memory system — verbatim conversation recall + temporal knowledge graph. Fixes the 'local LLMs have no memory between sessions' problem. Install: pip install mempalace && mempalace init ~/projects/<project>

playwright-search._comment: PRIMARY research backbone (in-house, no external services). Free local web research — multi-engine search (DDG + Brave + Bing) + page extraction (Readability + our own zero-dep bpm-pull) + 24h cache. Polite (rate-limited per-domain, robots.txt). Tools: web_research, web_search, web_fetch, web_search_pullmd, web_research_pullmd (the *_pullmd names are legacy; they now use our own pull with a Playwright fallback — no external pullmd service). Build with `npm run build` in /Users/user/Code/playwright-search, then point command at dist/mcp.js.

provider._comment: Uncomment the provider block you want to use. Remove this comment field.

lmstudio._comment: Local LLM via LM Studio — set baseURL to match your LM Studio server
lmstudio.name: LM Studio (local)

options._timeout_comment: M2 Max thinking turns exceed opencode's 300000ms default request timeout; disable it (false) or set >=1200000, and give chunkTimeout headroom so a slow local generation between chunks is not killed mid-turn.

ollama._comment: Local LLM via Ollama — uncomment to use instead of LM Studio
ollama.name: Ollama (local)
